thread.title: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P 500 Ease, But Lululemon Earnings Impress

author: KEN SHREVE
title: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P 500 Ease, But Lululemon Earnings Impress
text:
The stock market wasn't moving much in either direction as trade talks with Canada continued. Apple ( AAPL ) and Cisco Systems ( CSCO ) were top performers in the Dow. Besides Apple and Cisco, top gainers in the Nasdaq 100 included Ulta Beauty ( ULTA ), NetEase ( NTES ) and Nvidia ( NVDA ).
X In late-afternoon trading, the Nasdaq composite added around 0.1%, while the Dow Jones industrial average and S&P 500 eased 0.3% and 0.2%, respectively. Volumes on the NYSE and Nasdaq were tracking about 10% lower than Thursday's levels.
Inside the Dow Jones, Coca-Cola ( KO ) lost 1% on news it's buying international coffee chain Costa Coffee from U.K.-based Whitbread for just over $5 billion.
Stock Market Winners In stock market results today , Lululemon ( LULU ) delivered another impressive earnings report. Shares surged 15% after the company reported sales of $723.5 million, well above the consensus estimate of $667.9 million. Lululemon joined the IBD Leaderboard in February when it was getting support at the 10-week moving average.
Also in retail, shares of Ulta Beauty ( ULTA ) gapped up and tried to break out from a consolidation, but gains faded. Shares were up 6%. Investors looked past lukewarm guidance. Instead, Wall Street focused on news that Kylie Cosmetics will be available in Ulta stores later this year.
Meanwhile, after shedding 7% Thursday, shares of Tencent ( TCEHY ) fell 4.6% early but recovered off lows and were up a fraction. The stock crashed Thursday on reports that the Chinese government is considering limiting video game releases and setting restrictions on playing time.
In the semiconductor space, shares of Integrated Device Technology ( IDTI ) jumped nearly 13% on reports that Japanese automotive chipmaker Renesas might be interested in buying it. While chipmakers and chip-equipment firms continue to struggle, IBD's chip designer group is back near highs.
Integrated Device Techology has been a strong performer, along with Nvidia ( NVDA ), Semtech ( SMTC ), Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ) and Monolithic Power Systems ( MPWR ), among others.
Inside the MarketSmith Growth 250 , top gainers included Tilly's ( TLYS ), Tilray ( TLRY ) and Stitch Fix ( SFIX ), with gains of more than 6%.
